title: Contract Drafting and Commercial Negotiation Principles
description: Rigorous introduction to contract formation, covenants, warranties, indemnification clauses, dispute resolution provisions, and mitigating commercial liability.

title: Corporate Compliance and Ethics Fundamentals
description: Corporate governance principles, risk assessment methodologies, whistleblower policies, anti-corruption regulations (FCPA), and designing internal compliance programs.

title: USPTO Patent Examination & Intellectual Property Guide
description: Official USPTO guide covering patent prosecution, prior art searches, patent claims drafting, patentability criteria, trademark registration, and copyright protections.

title: IAPP Global Privacy Principles & GDPR Compliance Overview
description: Comprehensive reference on the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), lawful basis for processing, data subject rights, cross-border transfers, and Data Protection Officer (DPO) duties.

title: Federal Civil Procedure and Trial Practice Fundamentals
description: Exhaustive legal reference on the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure (FRCP), pleadings, Rule 12(b) motions to dismiss, Rule 26 discovery scope, summary judgment, and trial preparation.

title: Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP) 2023 Compliance & Consent Architecture
description: Authoritative compliance manual for the Indian Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 (DPDP Act). Covers Data Fiduciary obligations, Data Protection Board of India (DPBI), consent managers, penalty framework up to 250 crores, cross-border data transfer, and privacy compliance in Indian corporate enterprises.

child_chunks.title: DPDP Consent Architecture and Notice Requirements
child_chunks.content: Section 6 of DPDP Act 2023 mandates clear and unconditional consent accompanied by an itemised notice in 22 scheduled Indian languages. Data Fiduciaries must integrate registered Consent Managers.

child_chunks.title: Data Protection Board of India and Penalty Schedule
child_chunks.content: Schedule to the DPDP Act empowers the DPBI to levy financial penalties up to 250 crore INR for significant data breaches and failure to implement reasonable security safeguards.

title: Information Technology Act 2000 & CERT-In Cyber Security Compliance Framework
platform: CERT-In / Ministry of Electronics and IT
description: Definitive guide to the Information Technology Act 2000 (as amended 2008), Section 43A reasonable security practices (SPDI Rules), Section 66 cyber offences, CERT-In mandatory 6-hour cybersecurity incident reporting directions, and intermediary due diligence rules.

child_chunks.title: Section 43A and SPDI Rules
child_chunks.content: Section 43A of the IT Act imposes compensation liability for failure to protect Sensitive Personal Data or Information (SPDI). Requires formal Information Security Management Systems conforming to ISO 27001.

child_chunks.title: CERT-In 6-Hour Incident Reporting Directions
child_chunks.content: Under CERT-In Directions 2022, all body corporates and service providers must report cybersecurity incidents within 6 hours of notice, synchronise system clocks to NTP servers, and maintain logs for 180 days.

title: Companies Act 2013 Corporate Governance & RoC MCA Compliance Manual
description: In-depth corporate legal compliance curriculum under the Indian Companies Act 2013. Covers Registrar of Companies (RoC) MCA-21 e-filings, secretarial standards, board meetings, director duties, corporate social responsibility (CSR Section 135), and related party transactions.

title: Indian Contract Act 1872 & Commercial Litigation Advocacy (AIBE Syllabus)
platform: Bar Council of India / National Law School
description: Comprehensive Indian commercial law and litigation practice curriculum aligned with the All India Bar Examination (AIBE). Covers Indian Contract Act 1872 (consideration, breach, Section 73 liquidated damages), Code of Civil Procedure (CPC), commercial suits, arbitration under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act 1996, and transitional provisions under Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS).
